record.reason: LoRA-C applies parameter-efficient fine-tuning to robust CNN classifiers for IoT vision tasks. Parameter efficiency is a training property here; the paper does not optimize LLM inference, and its CNN architecture/task is distinct from the cited LoRA-pruning language-model system.
record.title: LoRA-C: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Robust CNN for IoT Devices
